subject.title: [Feature]: Guided CLI onboarding with live AI verification (macOS parity) and classic fallback

question: Should default interactive CLI onboarding switch from chat-first setup to a deterministic guided verifier that reuses detectSetupInference/activateSetupInference while preserving classic and scripted contracts?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but changing the default first-run CLI UX and fallback ladder is a protected maintainer/product decision, and an open PR already carries the proposed implementation.

options.title: Review guided verifier PR
options.body: Proceed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101880 or an equivalent replacement after conflicts and compatibility proof are resolved.

options.title: Narrow to live verification only
options.body: Keep the chat-first default but add a live test before persisting detected credentials, leaving manual-key guidance to the existing provider setup flow.

options.title: Defer the default UX change
options.body: Keep current CLI onboarding behavior and close or defer the linked PR until maintainers want a broader first-run redesign.

recommendation.title: Review guided verifier PR
recommendation.body: Proceed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101880 or an equivalent replacement after conflicts and compatibility proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current onboarding direction, the macOS verified setup engine, and the linked CLI implementation proposal.
